Frame: "Once you start productizing, you realize one tool isn't enough. Different stages of a project need different things."
Slide reveal: four rungs as a visual ladder, each with its diagnostic question:
Floor Tour: “
Does this floor size feel good?  Will it fit our needs?
”
Blueprint Immersive: "
Which (Revit) layouts do we like most?
 "
Hyperreal Estate: "
Does this final (Revit) layout feel correct in 3D?  What lighting?  What interactions?
 "
Holodeck: "
Customer, can you feel yourself buying this?
 "
Read the questions aloud. Audience starts mentally placing their own projects.
